title: Effect of sublethal treatments of imidacloprid against Aromia bungii on its parasitoid Sclerodermus guani
author: Li, Shuang
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Determine sublethal imidacloprid doses
steps.instruction: Conduct a bioassay with Aromia bungii adults to identify appropriate sublethal concentrations of imidacloprid.

steps.title: Feed larvae on treated artificial diet
steps.instruction: Prepare artificial diet containing the identified sublethal doses of imidacloprid, feed A. bungii larvae on it, then quantify their feeding amount and measure larval biomass.

substeps.instruction: Record the amount of diet consumed by each larva.
Weigh larvae to obtain biomass data.

steps.title: Measure CAT enzyme activity
steps.instruction: Collect A. bungii larvae after feeding on the imidacloprid‑treated diet and determine catalase (CAT) activity to assess changes caused by the treatment.

steps.title: Measure POD enzyme activity
steps.instruction: Using the same larvae, assay peroxidase (POD) activity to evaluate treatment‑induced changes.

steps.title: Measure SOD enzyme activity
steps.instruction: Determine superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity in the fed larvae to detect any alterations due to imidacloprid exposure.

steps.title: Measure CarE enzyme activity
steps.instruction: Assess carboxylesterase (CarE) activity in the larvae after they have consumed the sublethal imidacloprid diet.

steps.title: Measure GST enzyme activity
steps.instruction: Evaluate glutathione‑S‑transferase (GST) activity in the same larvae to monitor enzymatic response to the treatment.

steps.title: Evaluate S. guani performance
steps.instruction: Expose Sclerodermus guani to the imidacloprid‑fed A. bungii larvae and record emergence rate, maternal fecundity, and parasitic success rate.
